label: prop:cs-evaluation-faithfulness
title: Faithfulness of the Chern--Simons evaluation on the brane tower
html:
Let \Phi_n(K) denote the tower-level volume contribution from the tower decomposition. Let \kappa_n \in H^2(\mathcal{S}, \mathcal{B}) denote the n-th quantum characteristic class.

Proposition. The Chern--Simons evaluation map is faithful at each tower level. For every hyperbolic knot or link K in the Descartes spectrum,

  \kappa_n \neq 0 \quad \Longrightarrow \quad \Phi_n(K) \neq 0.

If \kappa_n defines a non-trivial obstruction in H^2(\mathcal{S}, \mathcal{B}), the Chern--Simons period integral over the n-th twisted sector yields a non-zero real contribution to \mathrm{Vol}(K).
